text: Unable to believe his eyes. <break time="0.8s" /> He let the paper fall onto his knees. <break time="0.8s" /> Without even looking. <break time="0.8s" /> At the number of the ticket. <break time="0.8s" /> He felt a pleasant chill. <break time="0.8s" /> In his stomach. <break time="0.8s" /> As if someone had poured cold water over him. <break time="0.8s" /> A tingling, terrible, sweet feeling. <break time="0.8s" /> Masha, 9, 499 is there. <break time="0.8s" /> He said in a strange, hollow voice. <break time="0.8s" /> That did not sound like his own. <break time="0.8s" /> Masha looked at his astonished, frightened face. <break time="0.8s" /> And understood at once. <break time="0.8s" /> That he was not joking. <break time="0.8s" /> 9, 499, she asked. <break time="0.8s" /> Turning pale. <break time="0.8s" /> And dropping the folded tablecloth. <break time="0.8s" /> Back onto the table. <break time="0.8s" /> Wait, not yet. <break time="0.8s" /> He answered. <break time="0.8s" /> When she asked about the ticket number. <break time="0.8s" /> But anyway, the number of our series is there. <break time="0.8s" /> He looked at his wife. <break time="0.8s" /> And gave a broad, foolish smile. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a baby who has just been shown a bright toy. <break time="0.8s" /> Masha smiled too. <break time="0.8s" /> Because she was just as glad as he was that he had not looked at the ticket number yet. <break time="0.8s" /> It is so sweet and so thrilling. <break time="0.8s" /> To tease yourself with the hope of a fortune. <break time="0.8s" /> That may soon be yours. <break time="0.8s" /> If I had checked the ticket number at once. <break time="0.8s" /> This sweet moment would have been over in a second. <break time="0.8s" /> Ivan thought.
